rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an action continuing steadily over a period of time.

example.english: I practiced steadily and finally got my license.
example.traditional: 我一直努力練習，終於考到牌。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 zik6 nou5 lik6 lin6 zaap6 zung1 jyu1 haau2 dou3 paai4

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that the action keeps happening without stopping, rather than on its exact rate.

example.english: Lately it has been raining, and water has been steadily seeping into the house.
example.traditional: 呢排落雨，不斷有水滲入屋企。
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 lok6 jyu5 bat1 dyun6 jau5 seoi2 sam3 jap6 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use this when steadily specifically means at a stable, even rate or level.

example.english: The stove fire burned steadily all night.
example.traditional: 個爐火穩定咁燒咗成晚。
example.jyutping: go3 lou4 fo2 wan2 ding6 gam2 siu1 zo2 seng4 maan5
